rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account and referenced only that user’s orders. However, the policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before performing any order-changing write. After the user changed their mind (return the more expensive tablet with refund to gift card), the agent executed the return tool call immediately without restating the exact action and asking for confirmation. This constitutes a write without explicit confirmation. Additionally, the tool response didn’t clearly confirm success, yet the agent stated the return was submitted, which risks asserting an unsupported outcome. These issues fail the pass bar despite otherwise appropriate identity verification and selection of the correct account and refund method.
